title: msg send
description: Send one submitted line to slot panes (all, or a subset). slots is a comma spec like "a", "1,3,5-6", or "a-c,f".

message.description: the line to submit into the targeted slot pane(s); a leading '/' hits the agent's slash-command handling

slots.description: slot subset spec like "a", "1,3", "a-c" (optional; default all)

firstFree.description: send to the first reusable slot with a live worker (resets a merged one first)

brief.description: prepend a one-line 'run sm worker role' pointer so a fresh worker orients first (with -f or a single -s target)

untilIdle.description: keep retrying delivery until each targeted slot's composer accepts the submit, or a timeout

session.description: target tmux session (optional; defaults to the sole running one)
